fields.description: Slot 0 header magic word; logical bytes 55 44 22 00 = 0x00224455.
fields.evidence: FUN_0807a9d8 compares header word auStack_34[0] against ROM constant; block fetched by FUN_0807e55c (EEPROM read, 4 halfwords per 8-byte block).
fields.name: slot0_magic

fields.description: Slot 0 header checksum half; 0xBBAA satisfies header_lo (0x4455) + payload byte sum (0) + stored = 0xFFFF.
fields.evidence: FUN_0807a9d8 accumulates payload bytes plus header halves and compares to stored half; written by FUN_0807a878 via FUN_0807e740; verified in baseline.
fields.name: slot0_checksum

fields.description: Slot 0 header tag half; zero padding completing the 8-byte EEPROM header block.
fields.evidence: Second half of 8-byte header block transferred as 4 halfwords by FUN_0807e55c and FUN_0807e60c; 0x0000 in baseline.
fields.name: slot0_header_tag

fields.description: Slot 0 context status byte (first byte of persisted 128-byte context); empty marker, rendered as '-' when slot is empty.
fields.evidence: RAM mirror at context +0x162 read by FUN_0804667c and FUN_080448a4; context loaded from EEPROM by FUN_0807aca0 into RAM +0xe2.
fields.name: slot0_state

fields.description: Slot 0 mission progress nibble (low 4 bits of context byte 6; high nibble holds unrelated flags).
fields.evidence: FUN_080448a4 stores (RAM mirror +0x168) & 0xf per slot; FUN_080465c4 init preserves the high nibble with & 0xf0.
fields.name: slot0_mission_step
